title: West PH Sea important issue to be tackled in 2028 polls – Teodoro
summary: The Chinese incursion in the West Philippine Sea is an important issue that should be discussed during the 2028 national elections, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said on Saturday.
